notes: M-12 wording: a signing key must be declared either by a key declaration record OR by the rotation record itself. This rotation explicitly lists new_public_key, so that material is an explicit declaration and the later record signed by it is valid. H0 only forbids inferring keys that never appear in any record's material (rotation-chain following is allowed for the revocation-authority rule only); a fully undeclared signer is covered by the core key-lifecycle/unknown-key vector.
